title: Étale-acyclic scheme
statement: For a scheme $T$, say that $T$ is etale acyclic if every jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $\{U_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] has a section after taking the coproduct $\coprod_i U_i\to T$ in schemes. Equivalently for an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum], every connected component is strictly henselian local [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology].

source.place: Hübner–Schmidt, Definition 7.8 and Proposition 7.9, étale case, printed pp. 14–15
